referenceIndex.source: SELECT COUNT(*) on brain_symbol / brain_relationship (validation/tools/bb_graph/recon.ts → results/recon.json)
referenceIndex.note: The campaign baseline describes 1,283,638 symbols / 4,418,260 relationships. The reference index present in this checkout answers 310,423 / 820,040. The measurements below are against what is on disk; the difference is recorded rather than reconciled.

case.whyThisSymbol: degree-measured leaf: 2 stored incoming rows, 0 outgoing (results/recon.json). The cheapest non-trivial target the index holds — a lower bound on what a default call costs.

T2-blocked.command: BB_DATA_DIR=$PWD/.bb-data BB_NO_AUTO_REFRESH=1 npx tsx validation/tools/bb_graph/probe.ts invariants
T2-blocked.outcome: killed after 10 minutes with no result; a single default call on a mid symbol did not return. The same sections complete in seconds on T0/T1 (same handler code path).
T2-blocked.reason: one statement per node costs 5-19 s on this index; a depth-3 walk expands up to 50 symbols per direction

statementProfileT2.interpretation: the cascade's owner range is not seeked (gravity index scan of the project's 310,423 symbols), the arms scan per-kind rows instead of seeking (project_id, relationship_type, target_symbol_id) which exists, and the unattributed counts scan for a NULL source. This is D-06, routed from bb_analyze and confirmed independently here.
